title: On Gaining the trust of the whole village
subtitle: 成功成就 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 成功成就（做人与做事·成功与成就）
meta: 主题语境：成功成就（做人与做事·成功与成就）　|　核心词汇：gain　|　正文 353 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 gain 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1973 the counsellor ① gained the trust of the whole village at once, and every listener in the garden said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three evenings on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the counsellor ② gains the trust of the whole village in the rain without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ gain the trust of the whole village at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ gained the trust of the whole village before — a line in the journal for June 1967 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Gaining the trust of the whole village at once, the counsellor said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the letter at the far bench, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ gain two pounds in a month in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Gain two pounds in a month at once and never mention it again.

By 1980 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the journal, and a new listener from the next garden ⑧ gains two pounds in a month at once every evening without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the bench, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ gained the trust of the whole village again when nobody else would.

⑩ To gain the trust of the whole village, my mother said in 1985, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the garden remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the garden forgets, somebody gains the trust of the whole village in the rain again and somebody must gain the trust of the whole village at once all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 获得（一般过去式 gained the trust of the whole village：1973 年谈心人头一回这样做，二话不说地）
B. v. 获得（一般现在 gains the trust of the whole village：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 获得（不定式 to gain the trust of the whole village：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 获得（过去完成时 had gained the trust of the whole village：1967 年六月的心记上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 获得（动名词 gaining the trust of the whole village 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 增加（gain two pounds in a month：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去增加一个月里重了两磅）
G. v. 增加（gain two pounds in a month：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 获得（后段两处：新来的倾听者照例 gains two pounds in a month，而母亲又一次 gained the trust of the whole village）

answers.why: gain 意为“获得”，1973 年谈心人二话不说地获得赢得全村人的信任，那是小园里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 gained。
gain 意为“获得”，自那以后谈心人淋着雨把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 gains。
gain 意为“获得”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯获得赢得全村人的信任”，此处为不定式 to gain the trust of the whole village。
gain 意为“获得”，心记里 六月 那行字说明早在 1980 年之前就有人获得过，故用过去完成时 had gained。
gain 意为“获得”，谈心人说“获得赢得全村人的信任这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 gaining the trust of the whole village 作主语。
gain 意为“增加”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去增加一个月里重了两磅”，should ever 之后用原形 gain two pounds in a month。
gain 意为“增加”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻增加一个月里重了两磅（gain two pounds in a month at once），以后再也不要提起。
gain 意为“获得”，新来的倾听者每个黄昏都照例增加一个月里重了两磅，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 gains。
gain 意为“获得”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次二话不说地获得赢得全村人的信任，用一般过去式 gained 叙述。
gain 意为“获得”，结尾那句是母亲 1985 年的话：要获得赢得全村人的信任，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和小园记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1973 年，谈心人二话不说地获得赢得全村人的信任；小园里每一个倾听者都说这是头一回。（gained the trust of the whole village）
多年以后，谈心人仍淋着雨做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（gains the trust of the whole village）

早在 1967 年就有人获得赢得全村人的信任，六月那天心记上的一行字就是证据。（had gained the trust of the whole village）
谈心人说过，二话不说地获得赢得全村人的信任这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（gaining the trust of the whole village 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻增加一个月里重了两磅，以后再也不要提起。（gain two pounds in a month，祈使句）

Three evenings on, the counsellor still gains the trust of the whole village in the rain without being asked.
My mother said later that to gain the trust of the whole village at all was the part nobody had expected.

Gaining the trust of the whole village at once, the counsellor said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 gain 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1973 the counsellor gained the trust of the whole village at once, and nobody in the garden forgot it.
Even now the counsellor gains the trust of the whole village in the rain whenever the garden asks.
Gaining the trust of the whole village at once, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever gain two pounds in a month in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new listener from the next garden gains two pounds in a month at once every evening, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother gained the trust of the whole village again, and the garden remembered that half.
